Name: Zadok, Son of Ahitub
Summary: Zadok, son of Ahitub, was priest alongside Abiathar through David's reign. He carried the ark back to Jerusalem when David fled Absalom, refused to leave the city, and later anointed Solomon king.
KeyStory: Zadok carried the ark back into danger and stayed loyal when the kingdom split.
KeyVerses: 2 Samuel 8:17; 2 Samuel 15:24; 2 Samuel 15:29; 2 Samuel 19:11; 1 Chronicles 6:8; 1 Chronicles 6:53; 1 Chronicles 12:28
RelatedPeople: Abiathar, Son of Ahimelech; King David; Ahimaaz, Son of Zadok; Ahitub, Son of Amariah
LifeLesson: Loyalty that stays when the king flees is the loyalty that crowns the next king.
